Name: Custom Greenhouse Redux
Author: NoisyFox
Description:
This is an update to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3464]Forkmaster's Custom Greenhouse[/url] which no longer works in Stardew Valley 1.6. It was my favourite greenhouse mod and permissions were open so I took it upon myself to fix it. I will remove this mod if Forkmaster ever returns and fixes the original.

[b]NOTE : [/b]Unlike the original mod the cellar is now a [b]completely seperate location / map [/b]- cellar access can be toggled on or off in config file (or GMCM)
[b]
[color=#ff0000]THIS MEANS THAT IF YOU USE MODS ALLOWING YOU TO PLACE MULTIPLE VANILLA GREENHOUSES IT IS LIKELY THAT THE CELLAR WILL BE SHARED BETWEEN ALL OF THEM[/color]
[/b]
I may make an optional single map version in future to address this for those of you who require it.

Like the original the greenhouse features :

[list]
[*]15x15 planting field which can fit 9 Iridium Sprinklers / 25 Quality Sprinklers perfectly
[*]16 spaces for planting trees
[*]A celler for kegs / casks etc. (casks enabled on this map) - [b]CAN BE TOGGLED OFF IN CONFIG[/b]
[/list]
